verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's own docs describe a dedicated Chrome/Brave/Edge/Chromium profile that the agent controls, framed as agent-controlled browser automation. Release notes highlight "live browser automation", and the product is positioned for browser workflows. This covers the core of driving a real browser on the user's behalf. missing for 10: explicit documentation of login/credential handling, clicking, and page-data extraction in the browser tool, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that browser automation works on live sites.
